items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Well, Preacher was such a funny guy anyway.

ctx.x: Oh, sure. I knew all of them. But I remember... Well, Preacher was such a funny guy anyway. He'd keep you in stitches all the time, you know. Oh, he was funny. Of course, everybody had their own character. Just like Gus. Gus was a showman, too. But I worked with Gus in so many different orchestras. You know?
